next_step.title: The next accessibility pass: the Activities tab
next_step.text: The UI pass names COBI's Activities tab, never checked before. The Dashboard passed in light and dark today, and the Fact Sheet moved to First Light.

calls.title: Read two records from the tab
calls.text: Irvine Valley's Art A.A. and Santa Monica's Barbering A.S. wait on your reading. Sign in on the Records view, open each record, and choose Confirm or Needs a fix.
calls.if_no_reply: Both records stay unchecked, and Sierra does not quote them.

notes.addenda: The reading agent starts after the Oct 11 census apply.
notes.procedures: 34 colleges have one since Oct 8: the 28 whose map host refuses or never reaches the reader each name the routes tried.
notes.sierra: The Fact Sheet is on First Light since Oct 9, in light and dark, and follows the theme you choose in COBI; print and the Word download keep their document type. The veteran map moved the same day, and the docked Sierra expands to full screen when she answers.
notes.maps: All 32 published maps are settled since Oct 8; Palo Verde's map columns were written that evening.

changes.text: The Library tab's open-asks record points at Sheet 57, after your paste.
The Dashboard tab passed its first accessibility pass in light and dark: its calculation notes, College Activity colors, focus rings and small buttons.
The Fact Sheet moved to First Light's type with a dark mode, after you said it looks great.
On the Fact Sheet, Ask Sierra and the Send button read clearly when you point at them.
SkyView's chip colors follow the house palette by day and at night, and three of its controls read clearly at night.
The accessibility pass now reaches a screen nobody has checked before it checks one again.
The funding explainer's Columns menu opens on the screen at every width, here and on this tab.
The privacy page uses the house fonts and follows the dark setting.
The Library's record of the decision sheets points at Sheet 56.
The Fact Sheet's links and buttons reach the 24px size, its toolbar uses words, and on a phone the toolbar scrolls away.
The Library's record of the decision sheets points at Sheet 55.
The public veteran map is on First Light, light and dark; inside COBI it fills its frame.
